fields.name: Name

races.csvHelp: Export every race, or check and import a file of new races. Imported races are always drafts.
races.detailIntro: Edit the race, its distances, claims and editions.
races.demoNotice: This is demo data. It can never be published.
races.statusHelp: Only a published race is visible on the website.

races.claimEvidenceHint: Where the written confirmation is kept. Required to switch a claim on.

editions.dateStatusHint: Mark the date as confirmed only when the organiser has announced it. Until then the website says it is not confirmed.
editions.provisionalNotice: The dates for this edition are not confirmed. The website shows that to visitors.
editions.detailIntro: Edit the dates, stock and packages of one edition.
editions.heading: {race} {year}

pools.title: Stock
pools.help: Entries, rooms and extras are drawn from stock pools. A pool that reaches its low-stock level shows a warning. A supplier confirmation is needed, but not enough, for guaranteed entry.
pools.caption: Stock pools
pools.label: Label
pools.thresholdHint: Warn when this many places or fewer are left. Leave blank for no early warning.
pools.confirmedHint: Tick only when the supplier has confirmed this stock in writing.

packages.caption: Packages in this edition

fields.name: Name

packages.csvHelp: Export this edition's packages, or check and import a file of new ones. Imported packages are drafts with no deposit; set the deposit on the package.
packages.detailIntro: Edit one package, then check how it will look.
packages.saleHelp: A draft package is hidden from the website. Opening a package needs its deposit.
packages.depositHelp: Prices and totals come later. This is only the deposit the package asks for.
